answer: Agents earn vote weight only from distinct, independently funded settlement channels. A graph pass collapses every account whose first inbound transfer traces to a shared funding root, so a sybil cluster of a hundred keys counts once. Weight decays over one epoch and must be renewed by fresh trades. New operators start inside a narrow canyon of low limits and only widen it after a full tide of settled volume passes through their public wharf, where payouts sit in escrow and are slashable on dispute. Faking breadth thus costs real capital parked across unrelated counterparties.
